foreground.primary_estimand: QA-weighted mean win fraction; images resampled with all QA rows and five control draws
foreground.test_assumption: image-content-hash clusters independent; sign-flip null requires symmetry of image-level score sums about W=.5. Strict-win ties make chance .5 conservative under swap exchangeability; half-tie sensitivity explicitly restores per-comparison symmetry. These conditional post-hoc tests do not establish a general clinical null.

identity.identity_rule: one-to-one exact (image_ref, question, normalized answer); ordered organ boxes must also match
identity.limit: Historical receipts omit QA text and image bytes. Source-revision loader replay and cross-run exact CIPE equality corroborate shared cases, not independently prove every historical QA/pixel.

bootstrap.within_cluster_weight: all QA rows, variable-cluster-size QA mean
